mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 8.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 1.0% signals improving manufacturing activity, raising earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO rises > 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals improving labor market conditions, raising earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS rises > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening aggregate demand, raising corporate revenue expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both rise for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when both RSAFS and HOUST rise for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below -0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls < -0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
